title.narrative: Poverty alleviation and inclusive development across rural Sindh

description.narrative: EU Delegation invited UNIDO along with other potential implementing agencies for submission of their proposal for implementation of PAIDAR project PAIDAR aims at supporting Government of Sindh to implement its Poverty Reduction Strategy (PRS) and direct implementation of Urban Economic Cluster pillar of PRS. EU Delegation to Pakistan in consultation with the Government of Sindh have decided to implement this action with UNIDO .
